statement: You are given a string s.
Return the longest substring of s that reads the same forwards and backwards. If several have the greatest length, any one of them is a correct answer.
Expanding around each centre, either a single character or the gap between two neighbours, finds it in O(n²) time and O(1) extra space.

examples.explanation: "bab" and "aba" are both palindromes of length 3 and either is correct; the expansion finds "bab" first.
The longest palindrome is the even-length "bb", found by expanding from the gap between the two b's.

constraints: s consists only of digits and English letters
